name: watcher
description: Observe agent skill usage and audit documentation drift from one consolidated watcher plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Audit docs and maintain skills from evidence
interface.longDescription: Watcher consolidates the former DocWatcher and Skill Watcher surfaces. It packages documentation alignment, housekeeping, skill maintenance, and semantic compression skills while keeping documentation audit and skill usage evidence in separate runtime domains.
defaultPrompt: Audit documentation drift, clean stale workspace artifacts, or analyze skill usage evidence with the appropriate watcher skill
